notes_for_editor: Two sources: the Lake County compilation PDF (its Cramer row says 80 ft, ladder, 1938, Mn MFS, tower 108) and the FFLA roster. The compilation contradicts itself on type: the table says ladder, the 1952 note says four-legged steel; the story reports both. Search summaries misattributed two things: the '100 feet high ... lookout cage' note belongs to the Finland tower (#107) in the PDF, not Cramer; and a '1978 note says taken down' is from the Fernberg entry, not Cramer. No removal year is given anywhere. No site description, photos, staffing or fire history found; two WebSearch calls used. The record's coordinates match the compilation within about 0.0001 degrees.
